contentPattern: cmp-card-highlighted: title + text + CTA plus carousel of flip cards (video) | Intro panel (title, text, CTA) plus carousel of flip cards with DM video/images (approved mapping cmp-card-highlighted -> cards-highlighted). Intro kept inside the block per the approved mapping.

cells: H2 'An ungeometric geometry', lead paragraph, CTA link 'See more on Instagram' -> https://www.instagram.com/thisisbarcelona_official

blockContent.notes: First row is the intro panel; following rows are the flip cards shown in the carousel.

usage: Row 1 is the intro panel (leave the first cell empty; second cell holds H2, text and CTA). Each following row is a flip card: media (Scene7 video link and/or image) | optional back-face text. Cards with back text flip on click or Enter/Space.
reuseGuidance: Use for an editorial intro next to a carousel of vertical video/image cards. For a static grid of cards, use cards.
